title: The Door Opens
summary: The third Brogath is in the treasure room. You are sure of it.
description: The crew are up on deck fighting the storm. The treasure room is down below, sealed, signed and planked. Nobody is watching it. Nobody is watching YOU.

objectives.text: Slip below while they're busy (the main hatch, the galley, then down the stairs to the hold)
See what they've nailed to it (the treasure-room door)
Take the barricade down, plank by plank (the door)
Open it. Just a crack. (the door)

title: The Plume
summary: It isn't dispersing. It's going somewhere.
description: A plume of the old treasure-room cloud got out, and it isn't spreading out like a smell should. It's moving. On purpose. Follow it.

objectives.text: Follow the plume (up the stairs, into the galley)
Follow it (through the door at the bottom of the galley)

title: Brogath Returns
description: The plume went into cardboard Brogath. Cardboard Brogath has just asked where he is.

objectives.text: Say something to him (Brogath)

title: The Containment Corner
summary: We're not moving him. We're moving US.
description: Nobody is going to try and move Brogath. The crew are building themselves a corner instead, and somebody has to write some rules.

objectives.text: Build the barricade (the card table, the Grog cask, sash blankets, cardboard Sir Rumpus)
Help Pete start the rules (the barricade)
Check on Garrick (out there with him)

title: Keep Brogath Confident
summary: Confidence is the only thing that works.
description: Pete has noticed something. Brogath goes off when he's embarrassed, and the worst thing for embarrassment is anything that FLUTTERS. Handle it. Whatever it is.

objectives.text: Hear Pete's theory (Pete)
Handle whatever flutters: secure it, then steady him (talk to Brogath)
Add to the rules (the barricade)

title: The Apology Eruption
summary: He apologised. And now it's getting WORSE.
description: The flutter from his own eruption is embarrassing him, which makes the eruption bigger, which makes more flutter. Break the loop: brace, secure everything loose, and get to him.

objectives.text: BRACE! (the mast post)
Secure the loose sashes (the sash hammocks)
Stop what's sliding (the bedroom set, the Mega-Pack)
Catch the lantern (the swinging one)
Get to him through the cloud and talk him down (Brogath)

title: Back in Office
description: The suspension is over. The Grand Stenchmaster would like his regalia back, starting with the sash in your wardrobe. You are not touching that sash with your hands.

objectives.text: Get something long (the fire tongs, by the galley stove)
Get the sash out of your wardrobe (your cabin), with the tongs
Give it back (Garrick, the galley)
Hear his Grand Decrees (Garrick)

title: Two Grand Stenchmasters
description: Garrick is the current Grand Stenchmaster. Brogath is an ancient one. Neither of them can see why that should make the other one superior. Keep it from turning into a contest.

objectives.text: Keep it from becoming a contest (Garrick, Brogath)

title: The Grand Waft Trials
summary: An ancient competition. Postponed. Indefinitely. Please.
description: Brogath mentioned the Grand Waft Trials, the ancient way two Grand Stenchmasters settled who was grander. Garrick heard. Make sure they never happen.

objectives.text: Make sure the Grand Waft Trials never happen

title: Beans of Ancient Precedent
summary: Two Grand Stenchmasters. One breakfast. Beans.
description: Both Grand Stenchmasters must be kept content: compliments, in turns, so neither gets jealous. Then breakfast, by decree. Overlapping modern and ancient Grand authority. Beans.

objectives.text: Keep them both content: a compliment each, by turns (Garrick, Brogath)
Serve breakfast: beans, onions (stove), garlic (jar), cabbage (crock), Frog Grog (cask), Sauce (crate)
EMERGENCY MEETING! (the little door under the hold stairs)

title: The Fart-Free Zone
summary: It's small. It's under the stairs. It's ours.
description: The nook under the hold stairs is the only room on the ship nobody has ever farted in. Make it a Fart-Free Zone, and make it safe.

objectives.text: Hold the meeting (Pete)
Make it safe: blankets, pillows, mattress, clean sashes, barrels, rags, hardtack, cards, Frog Grog (round the ship)
Be pirates for a minute (the cards)

title: Getting Rid of Brogath
description: Brogath has to leave the ship. Everyone has a plan. Hear them all.

objectives.text: Hear the plans (Jim, Gristle, Bob, Ned)
Hear Pete's (Pete)

title: Beyond Broke
description: A quiet night. The Grand Stenchmaster is asleep, and so is his pocket edition. Read what it says about Brogath's OTHER treasure.

objectives.text: Read it, by lamplight (the pocket edition, in the zone)
Write it down (the slate)
Put up a warning (the foot of the hold stairs)

title: The Grand Economy of Farts
summary: He never admitted he was poor.
description: After he was beyond broke, Brogath invented money. Read on.

objectives.text: Read on (the pocket edition)
Get some sleep (the mattress)

title: Bad Money
description: Brogath is very pleased with himself about something. Something involving the Bling Bling King, a catalogue, and your purse.

objectives.text: See what's got Brogath so pleased (the old quarters)
Check your purse (the desk, your cabin)
Get the delivery below (on deck, by the forward hatch)
Open it (the crate, in the galley)

title: Grand Temporary Ancient Oat Security Officer
description: The plan: keep Brogath busy with harmless, important-sounding jobs. The first: guarding the oats.

objectives.text: Give Brogath an important job (Brogath)
Fetch the oats (three sacks: the galley stores)
Check on him (the galley)
Sweep up (the galley floor)

title: Important Television Duty
description: Brogath can't guard oats. But there's one thing he might be able to do without moving at all.

objectives.text: Find him something he'll sit still for (the bedroom set)
Find the right channel (the bedroom set)
Watch it with him (Brogath)

title: The Sash Flutter Commercial
summary: The Bling Bling King has bought advertising.
description: A commercial break. A sash, fluttering, in slow motion. Then two. Then six. Brogath is watching all of them.

objectives.text: Cover his eyes (Brogath)
Change the channel (the bedroom set)
Tie down the sashes nearby (the sash hammocks)
Shut the doors (the galley door, the deck hatch)
Talk him through it (Brogath)

title: The Grand Bank
description: Twenty thousand tokens of Grand Currency, and not one of them is worth anything. Ask Brogath about this bank of his. All of it.

objectives.text: Ask him about the bank (Brogath)
Take your badge (Brogath)

title: Your Gas Is Our Business
summary: The branch is open. You are the teller.
description: THE GRAND STENCHMASTER'S GRAND BANK AND GRAND TRUST is open for deposits. Take each depositor's sash, brace, and record what kind of deposit it was.

objectives.text: Serve the depositors (ring the teller bell, behind the counter)

title: Legendary Depositors
description: Word has got round the afterlife. Three more. Legendary ones.

objectives.text: Serve the legends (the teller bell)

title: The Branch Concludes Business
description: The bank is dissolving. You have twenty thousand tokens and about a minute.

objectives.text: REDEEM THE TOKENS (the vault, quick!)
Ask him what they're for (Brogath)
Ask for the bank back, without you in it (Brogath)

title: Distinguishedly Furious
description: You said everything stinks. You said Brogath reeks. He took it very badly. It has been going on for ten minutes. Go into the plume and console him.

objectives.text: Go into the plume and console him (the old quarters)

title: The Brogath Problem
summary: How do you get rid of a reincarnated Grand Stenchmaster?
description: In the Fart-Free Zone, with the pocket edition: find out how to get rid of Brogath. Properly. Safely. For good.

objectives.text: Read up on dispersing him (the pocket edition, in the zone)
Do the sums (the slate)
Tell him (Brogath, the old quarters)

title: Mandatory History Night
description: A night in the Fart-Free Zone. Nobody touched the television.

objectives.text: Get some sleep (the mattress, in the zone)
See what's on (the Mark II, in the galley)
Turn it off. Somehow. (the Mark II)
Watch it, apparently (Brogath)
Commercial break! Cover his eyes, tie the sashes down, change the channel
Explain the sashes (Brogath)
